# obsidian-servicenow-docs

> ServiceNow platform documentation vault (~46,000 official docs) + curated Unit4 implementation notes + a self-maintaining wiki synthesis layer + Claude Code agent memory. Flat, low-token index for AI agents — one line per directory. For per-subdirectory detail, drill into `ServiceNowOfficialDocs/INDEX.md`; for per-file detail in a large leaf directory, drill into that directory's own `INDEX.md` (present wherever a leaf dir has >100 files).

## Start here
- CLAUDE.md: AI agent guide — read first, defines navigation rules, session conventions, wiki schema
- ServiceNowOfficialDocs/INDEX.md: master category → subdirectory index for official docs (~50 categories, ~300 subdirs, 107 subdirs have their own per-file INDEX.md)
- wiki/index.md: curated synthesis layer (entities, concepts, decisions) — check before re-deriving anything from raw docs
- README.md: full vault architecture, LLM Wiki pattern, self-evolving memory system

## Other vault content (outside ServiceNowOfficialDocs/)
- Notion/ServiceNow/: personal Notion export, browse by topic folder (AI & VA, CMDB, Flow Designer, Security & ACL, etc.)
- Applications/<app>/: notes on in-house custom ServiceNow apps (e.g. capacity-planner, sn-instance-scan) — app-specific detail lives here, not in wiki/entities/
- ClaudeAgents/: BA → Architect → Governance → Developer → Tester pipeline for building ServiceNow features end-to-end; start with `ClaudeAgents/README.md`
- ClaudeSkills/: Claude Code skills used during agent work (agent-dispatch, todo-fixer)
- wiki/: LLM Wiki synthesis layer — entities/ (concrete things), concepts/ (cross-cutting topics), syntheses/ (evolving theses), queries/ (filed answers), index.md, log.md
- graphify/<project>/: auto-generated codebase knowledge graphs, one per mapped repo — never edit manually
- logs/: manual session logs written via the `/save` command
- raw/sessions/: auto-captured session logs from claude-memory-compiler, unreviewed until `compile.py` promotes facts into wiki/
- raw/inbox/: landing zone for new sources awaiting wiki ingest
- chats/code/: imported Claude Code conversations, tagged `chat-import`
- Dashboards/: Obsidian Bases dashboards (Applications, Wiki Health, CTA Study, Notion Reference)
- Clippings/: ad-hoc web clippings
- scripts/: vault maintenance scripts — see Tools below

## Tools (use before reading raw files)
- semantic_search MCP tool (server: smart-connections): meaning-ranked search across the whole vault, phrasing-agnostic — primary retrieval for the ClaudeAgents pipeline and general Q&A
- scripts/frontmatter_search.py <query>: fast local keyword search (AND across terms) over cached title/description/tags for all of ServiceNowOfficialDocs — narrowing/triage only, always Read the winning file's body before answering from it; rebuild the cache first with scripts/build_frontmatter_cache.py if missing or stale
- obsidian-cli (skill): literal keyword search fallback if semantic_search is unreachable, plus read/create/append/property operations on notes
- scripts/gen_indexes.py: regenerates the per-file INDEX.md for every ServiceNowOfficialDocs leaf directory with >100 markdown files (no args needed, auto-discovers qualifying dirs)
